thread:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx + timeouts observed across api-prod-us-east-1. Error rate jumped from ~0.5% to 12% at 12:01 UTC. Automatic paging to #incidents.
Oncall Bot: incident_id=INC-20260314-137. Primary symptom: client-facing 502/504 and gateway timeouts. Many 429s observed earlier in edge logs.
Alex Chen: seeing same in dashboard — spikes align with quota-service errors. 429s around 11:58, followed by backend queues saturating and then 502s from the runtime.
Maria Gonzalez: confirmed: rate-limiter returned 429s for several tenants after a config change rolled out in dedicated-rate-limits service at ~11:55 UTC.
Jamal Patel: who rolled that config? I see a deploy from pipeline #deploy-frontend-rate at 11:54 by kiana.r
Kiana Roberts: that was me — quick quota tweak to reduce default per-tenant burst to 100 -> 50 to control noisy tenants. Did a canary then rollout.
Maria Gonzalez: ok that reduction caused aggressive throttling; upstream backoffs weren’t handling 429s gracefully, clients retried heavily and overloaded the API gateway -> cascading 5xx.
Alex Chen: mitigation idea: rollback rate-limit change, enable soft-queueing on ingress, and temporarily scale up gateway instances. Which is fastest?
Jamal Patel: rollback is fastest. We can rollback the rate-limit config via envoy config manager: `curl -X POST $CONFIG_MGR/revert -d '{"change_id":"deploy-2026-03-14-11-54"}'`
Kiana Roberts: running rollback now. Patch will target `dedicated-rate-limits` and `global-defaults`. Pushing in 2s.
Oncall Bot: deploy started: revert job #revert-1765432130 triggered by kiana.r
Kiana Roberts: revert complete — verified config back to burst=100. Confirming service health checks.
Maria Gonzalez: I’m watching request histograms — 429s trending down within last 30s, but we still see elevated queue depth on runtime nodes.
Alex Chen: starting quick autoscale for gateway: `kubectl scale deployment gateway-prod --replicas=8 -n prod` — bumped from 4 to 8.
Jamal Patel: temporarily enabling throttled retry-window on client-proxy to stop aggressive immediate retries: set `retry_backoff_ms=2000` for 60m.
Kiana Roberts: done. Also flipped fallback routing to lower-cost model for non-enterprise tenants to reduce token load: `route.override=fallback-small`.
Oncall Bot: System note: health-check alerts cleared for rate-limits service. Gateway error rate down from 12% -> 2.1% in patch window.
Alex Chen: running targeted traffic replay to validate stability; watching p50/p95 latency. p95 still elevated but trending down.
Priya Singh: I'm on standby for customer comms. Early impact: a handful of customers saw 502s & higher latency for ~6 minutes. Any high-severity customers impacted?
Maria Gonzalez: flagged two enterprise tenants (acme-inc, beta-health) for >1% error spikes. Recommend CS reach out with heads-up and mitigation summary.
Customer Success Bot: Noted. Opening case CS-4553 for ACME; pinging accounts.
Jamal Patel: collecting logs for postmortem: `jq '. | {ts,tenant,code,route}' edge-logs-20260314.json | grep -E "(429|502|504)" > incident-logs-1765432100.log`
Alex Chen: capturing heap/queue metrics from runtime nodes and snapshotting current kernel selection to ensure no regressions from fallback.
Kiana Roberts: action items for now: 1) keep reverted rate-limit config 2) monitor for 30m 3) follow-up to add gradual ramp guard to future changes (circuit-breaker rollouts) 4) update retry logic to jittered exponential backoff.
Maria Gonzalez: agree. I'll also add automated canary checks for request queuing and retry amplification before allowing rate-limit rollouts.
Priya Singh: drafting customer note: "We experienced a short service disruption caused by a quota configuration change; we rolled back the change and throttled retries to stabilize traffic. We'll follow up with root cause and mitigation steps." Will post after you confirm wording.
Alex Chen: wording fine. Add ETA for longer-term fix: 1 week for rollback safeguards and 2 weeks for retry/backoff refactor.
Oncall Bot: Incident status: mitigated — service stabilized. Keeping channel open for monitoring and follow-ups. Incident state -> MONITORED.
Kiana Roberts: creating postmortem ticket: PM-1765432100, assigning to eng-runtime + eng-sre + devex for retry/backoff.
Jamal Patel: quick note: add a runbook step to check canary throttling impact on client-side retry behavior — we underestimated amplification.
Maria Gonzalez: logging follow-up: correlate per-tenant retry counts to rate-limiter responses and add SLO guard to prevent global fallback when retries surge.
Priya Singh: CS sent initial heads-up to impacted customers. Will coordinate postmortem summary once available.
Customer Success Bot: Cases opened: ACME-CS-4553, BETAHEALTH-CS-4554. Customers notified.
Alex Chen: thanks all. Closing live mitigation. Will keep an eye on p95 for next hour and report back in 30m.
Oncall Bot: This thread will be archived after 24h. Actions captured: revert rate-limit, scale gateway, throttle retries, fallback routing, postmortem ticket created. :thumbsup:
